claims.text: Trimethoprim/polymyxin B 2–4×/day for 7–10 days is the alternative to a fluoroquinolone drop (eg, moxifloxacin 0.5%)
claims.quote: most clinicians treat presumptively with a broad-spectrum topical antibiotic (eg, moxifloxacin 0.5% drops or another fluoroquinolone or trimethoprim/polymyxin B 2 to 4 times a day for 7 to 10 days)
